functional_requirements.title: Hash password using SHA-256
functional_requirements.description: The system must provide a function hash_password(password) that returns the SHA-256 hexadecimal digest of the input password.

functional_requirements.title: In-memory user credential store
functional_requirements.description: Maintain an in-memory dictionary (users_db) that maps usernames to their corresponding password hashes for authentication.
acceptance_criteria: Users 'admin' and 'user' exist in the store
Stored passwords are hashes, not plaintext
The store is in-memory and not persisted to disk

functional_requirements.title: Authenticate credentials
functional_requirements.description: The function authenticate(username, password) must validate that the username exists and the hashed input password matches the stored hash.
acceptance_criteria: Returns True for valid username and correct password
Returns False if the username does not exist or the password is incorrect

functional_requirements.title: Login flow and user interaction
functional_requirements.description: The function login() must present a username and password prompt (in French), call the authentication logic, and print a success or failure message accordingly.
acceptance_criteria: Prompts shown: 'Nom d'utilisateur' and 'Mot de passe'

functional_requirements.title: Script entry point starts login flow
functional_requirements.description: When the module is executed as the main program, the login flow (login()) must be started automatically.
acceptance_criteria: Running the script directly calls login()
No automatic login occurs when the module is imported

user_stories.title: User can authenticate with username and password
user_stories.description: As a user, I want to login with a username and password so that I can authenticate to the system.
acceptance_criteria: Given valid credentials, When I attempt to login, Then I see 'Connexion réussie !'
Given invalid credentials, When I attempt to login, Then I see 'Identifiants incorrects'

user_stories.title: Developer can run login flow directly
user_stories.description: As a developer, I want the login flow to start automatically when the script is run directly to ease testing.
acceptance_criteria: When the script is executed as __main__, login() is invoked
Login prompts appear and authentication flow executes

business_rules.rule: Passwords are stored as SHA-256 hashes and compared by hashing the input password during authentication.
business_rules.implementation: The in-memory store holds password hashes (hashes in users_db) and authenticate() compares the stored hash with hash_password(input_password).
business_rules.validation: Authentication succeeds only if the input password hashes to the same value as the stored hash for the given username.

data_flows.source: user input (username, password) via login prompts
data_flows.transformation: password is hashed by hash_password(password); username is checked against users_db; if present, compare hashed input with stored hash
data_flows.validation: authentication result (True/False) determines which message is printed

data_flows.transformation: lookup of stored password hash by username
data_flows.validation: ensures username exists in the store; otherwise authentication fails
